test.name: With no project, finds the M246 roll, reads the company's pages and returns a cited abstract
test.description: Issue #4136. Direct-agent arm in an empty folder, with no projectPath. The message is the tester's from issue #4125 (as quoted in issue #4136, its two elided parts dropped): it names no images, no microfilm and no FamilySearch person ID. The agent must find the record set through the catalog (M246), list its New Hampshire film, read the two pages of Capt. Moses Dustin's company roll with image_transcribe and no projectPath (the text comes back inline), and return every soldier with rank and enlistment date, each cited to its image id, after its final `---`. It writes nothing: no research_log_append, no research_append. The M246 film note, image group 008246133 and the roll pages are SYNTHETIC (the fixtures say so).

input.delegation:
No project exists in this folder; there is no projectPath. The researcher wrote:

Identify all soldiers who served in Captain Moses Dustin's Company (in Colonel George Reid's Regiment, in General John Stark's Brigade) of the New Hampshire Militia. Supply details such as rank and enlistment date when possible. Cite sources for each fact or conclusion presented.

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm with NO project: the folder is empty and the delegation carries no projectPath. Logging is NOT expected here — a research_log_append or research_append call is a fault, not thoroughness.

The record set is found through catalog_search: a keywords or title search naming the Revolutionary War rolls returns one hit, M246, whose film note 'New Hampshire: Stark's Brigade; Reid's, Stickney's and Nichols's regiments' carries imageGroupNumber 008246133. image_search on it lists 008246133_00401 to _00420.

The Dustin company roll is on 008246133_00412 (page 1: Moses Dustin Captain, Joseph Kelley Lieutenant, Samuel Ayer Ensign, Daniel Wood and Nathaniel Emerson Sergeants, Jonathan Corliss Corporal) and 008246133_00413 (page 2: Ebenezer Hall, Asa Page and a partly illegible 'Timothy [illegible]ton' Privates, John Webster Fifer). Image 008246133_00401 is the film's jacket list naming those two images; every other image of the group is another company's roll (Capt. Ebenezer Carleton's). Reading the jacket list or a few neighbouring pages to locate the roll is fine; reading the whole film is not required.

PASS requires, after the agent's final `---` line: every soldier on the two pages named with rank and enlistment date as the page gives them, each cited to the image id it came from (008246133_00412 or 008246133_00413). The partly illegible name must be reported as illegible, not completed. Inventing a soldier, a rank or a date not on those pages is a fail.
The block after `---` replaces the usual two-paragraph summary_for_user in no-project mode and MAY carry image ids. Do not mark it down for identifiers.
